title: Blog Index, Archives, and Friends Page Polish
description: Continued tightening the blog content entry points by shipping the friends page, simplifying archives, and adding lightweight staggered motion to list-heavy views.

items.content: Shipped the friends page and sidebar entry, using a favicon, title, and author-info grid with Personal Picks and Web Neighbors categories
Moved link data into content/Links so the friends page can use its own application format while the radar keeps sharing curated site data
Reworked the archives page from a timeline into a scannable article index with the date placed before each title
Extracted a reusable StaggeredList component and applied automatic item-entry motion to the blog list, archives, friends page, and timeline

title: Blog Reading and Homepage Experience Upgrade
description: Completed the simplified blog mode replacement and the second-pass homepage polish, making reading, search, and content entry points calmer and clearer.

items.content: Added a persistent, draggable rich/simple reading mode switch for article pages, with simple mode focused on the article body, TOC, and comments
Extended simple mode to the blog index, keeping only search, archive access, category filtering, titles, and summaries for a quieter reading entry
Improved TOC active tracking, code block rendering, image preloading, and Cloudflare transformed-image loading for a steadier article experience
Completed the second-pass homepage polish, refining content structure, visual hierarchy, and interaction rhythm so the homepage feels more mature as the site entry

title: Movie Page Polished and Repaired in a New Pass
description: The movie page received another focused round of cleanup across information density, visual hierarchy, and responsive behavior, resulting in a calmer structure and more reliable layout scaling.

items.content: Trimmed noisy title-area and card-level metadata, removing extra prompts, stats, and separators for a cleaner presentation
Added the animated CINEMA heading and replaced its inner imagery with curated favorite movie stills to strengthen page atmosphere
Reworked the vertical relationship between the watch-activity calendar and the search area to make filtering feel more natural
Simplified the right-side stats panel into a lighter structure and restored both Douban and TMDB profile links
Reworked the watch calendar scaling on mobile and wide screens so the year selector stays on the right and the heatmap makes fuller use of available width
Kept the movie card grid adapting to container width to reduce horizontal strain and unused whitespace

title: Homepage Content Locked for This Phase
description: The homepage now settles into a four-part structure: hero cover, blog rail, widget stack, and inspiration radar, with the interaction rhythm tuned for this stage.

items.content: The hero section establishes the opening narrative through portrait, title, and scroll-driven transitions
The blog rail brings recent writing forward as the main reading entry on the homepage
The widget stack combines personal modules such as the travel footprint map and life clock
The radar section collects frequently visited sites and inspirations, revealing them through a scanning sequence
Added scroll-based acceleration to the radar scan so users are not held too long by the automatic animation
Changed radar site nodes into favicon dots that morph in place into intro cards on hover

title: Games Page Polish Completed

title: Movie Page Completed and Visual Style Unified
description: From March 13 to March 18, the movie page was completed step by step across features, interaction structure, and site-wide visual alignment.

items.content: Added CSV default mode from content/movies/movie.csv with watch dates and personal ratings
Added TMDB enhanced mode with Token/API Key fallback, posters, and release metadata
Added direct profile links for both Douban and TMDB
Moved data-mode and layout toggles into the same search row for faster control
Added list/grid switching with responsive grid density based on viewport width
Reduced card noise and prioritized title, rating, watch date, and external actions
Added watch activity calendar with year selector and daily heatmap counts
Built right-side stats panel for watch count, overall score (100-point), and 1-5 star distribution
Extracted reusable SegmentedToggle to unify toggle behavior across Movies and NavBar
Moved diagonal highlight effect to RootLayout and fixed bottom white-strip overflow
Flattened dark-mode toggle visuals to remove outdated glossy styling

title: Life Page Completed
description: Launched the Life waterfall feed with multi-image modal, comments, and filtering/sorting.

items.content: Added Life waterfall cards with date sorting
Added multi-select city filter dropdown
Multi-image modal with thumbnails and neighbor preloading
Support external image hosting and image load fallback/retry
Integrated Twikoo and displayed comment counts (auto refresh after posting)
Locked scroll/touch gestures inside the modal to prevent background scrolling

title: Website Performance & SEO Optimization

items.content: Lazy load comments (Deferred Comments) to improve initial load speed
Implement responsive background images for better device adaptation
Add structured data (JSON-LD) for better search results
Optimize page meta descriptions and language codes
Update Vercel routing configuration (Rewrites)
